verses.text: "My spirit is broken. My days have burned out, and the grave is waiting for me.
Mockers surround me. I have to sit here watching them provoke me.
God, put up a pledge for me yourself. Who else will give me their hand as a guarantee?
You've kept them from understanding, so you won't let them triumph.
Anyone who betrays friends for a share of the spoils will see even their children's eyes fail.
God has made me a byword among the people. They spit in my face.
My eyes have grown dim from grief, and my whole body is a shadow of what it was.
Upright people are appalled at this. The innocent are stirred up against the godless.
Still, the righteous hold to their way, and those with clean hands grow stronger and stronger.
As for all of you, come back and try again. I won't find a single wise person among you.
My days have passed. My plans and the deepest desires of my heart have fallen apart.
They call night day. In the middle of the darkness they say, 'The light is near.'
If I look to Sheol as my home and spread out my bed in the dark,
if I say to decay, 'You're my father,' and to the worm, 'You're my mother and my sister,'
then where is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
Will it go down with me to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down into the dust together?"
